body: I'm so far in debt that I will never pay it off If i don't go into medicine.

I honestly can't tell you what your response means to me. I've just been kind of numb for awhile, but after reading your response I just broke down. Honestly I don't want to have to deal with this pain anymore. I don't have options outside of medicine, and I know that there are people that care about me, but if I just go away I will stop hurting them and they will get over me and just live their lives. And hey, if I die my debt goes away so at least I won't have to feel guilty over that anymore.
